question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (2)
solution:
The correct answer is: **period**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"period"** refers to a length or portion of time; era. (अवधि)

 
 
• **Example: **We studied the Renaissance period in our history class.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that an asteroid as large as 10 kilometres (6 miles) in diameter is thought to have struck Earth towards the end of the Cretaceous era, according to a number of geological lines of evidence. 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word for the blank is **'period'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **period**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Space** (स्थान): An empty area that is available to be used.

 
 
• **Example:** There is enough space in the room for a new table.
 
 
 
• **Spell** (अवधि): A short period of time during which something lasts.
 
 
• **Example: **She had a brief spell of illness last week.
 
 
 
• **Span** (अवधि): The full extent or length of something from end to end.
 
 
• **Example:** The bridge has a span of 200 meters.
